description: A bare true static map key analyzed as a static traversal is the root true
notes: Read as the keyword, true is a static traversal rooted at true, but read as a literal attribute name, as hashicorp/hcl evaluates this key (native/analysis/map-key-true-keyword), the spec doesn't say whether a bare key is a variable expression that can be a static traversal. hashicorp/hcl's ObjectConsKeyExpr.AsTraversal (hclsyntax/expression.go) gives the traversal of the wrapped true literal, which LiteralValueExpr.AsTraversal turns back into a root named true.
